end.summary:
Estimated answers by rounding numbers before subtraction and addition.
Practised checking subtraction with addition and addition with subtraction as inverse operations.
Got 4 of 6 inverse-operation checks correct without help.
The mix-up about using the wrong inverse was corrected later in the lesson.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised estimating first and using inverse operations to check calculations. The bar model helped show that the subtracted amount and the amount left combine to make the whole; the wrong-inverse mix-up was corrected later. At home, ask them to check one subtraction by adding the difference to the smaller part and seeing whether it makes the starting number.
